commands.review_summary:
The PR makes Agent Sessions Tailscale discovery probe standard CLI-wrapper locations before the app executable, adds a CLI-mode environment marker, adds four focused tests, and updates the changelog.

Reproducibility: yes. at high confidence from current source and the linked report: a GUI-minimal PATH misses the installed wrapper and selects the dual-mode app executable, and the reporter provides a concrete command-level reproduction matrix.

target.title: fix: keep Tailscale session discovery headless
target.body:
## Summary
- Resolve the `tailscale` CLI wrapper during Agent Sessions host discovery even under a minimal `PATH` (probe `/usr/local/bin` and `/opt/homebrew/bin`, not just the inherited `PATH`), before falling back to the app bundle binary.
- When the app-binary fallback is used, run it with a shell marker (`SHLVL`) in its environment so it stays in CLI mode instead of launching the Tailscale menu bar GUI.

Fixes the Tailscale menu bar icon flickering on and off every refresh. Related to the Agent Sessions discovery work in #2079.

Closes #2098.

## Root cause
`RemoteSessionFetcher.discoveredHosts` resolves the Tailscale binary via `findExecutable("tailscale", environment:)`, which searches only `environment["PATH"]`, then falls back to `/Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale`. A GUI-launched CodexBar inherits a minimal `PATH` (`/usr/bin:/bin`) that omits `/usr/local/bin`, so the CLI wrapper is missed and the probe hits the app bundle binary.

That binary is dual-mode: with no shell/terminal marker in its environment it launches the full menu bar GUI (SkyLight/WindowServer, status icon) instead of running the CLI. It never emits JSON, the 5s timeout kills it, and the icon flickers — every 65–90s, all day (≈997 GUI launches in a 24h window on my machine). Logs show repeated `Subprocess timed out (binary=Tailscale label=Tailscale session host discovery)`.

Verified levers (Tailscale 1.98.5, each `env -i … status --json`):

| Invocation | Result |
|---|---|
| `/usr/local/bin/tailscale` (CLI wrapper) | CLI ✓ |
| bundle binary + `TERM` | CLI ✓ |
| bundle binary + `SHLVL` | CLI ✓ |
| bundle binary, no marker | GUI / hangs ✗ |
| bundle binary, lowercase `argv[0]`, empty env | GUI / hangs ✗ |
| bundle binary + `XPC_SERVICE_NAME=0` | GUI / hangs ✗ |

The `/usr/local/bin/tailscale` wrapper is a `#!/bin/sh` script that re-execs the bundle binary; it stays in CLI mode only because `/bin/sh` sets `SHLVL`. So the reliable lever is a shell/terminal marker in the environment — this PR mirrors `SHLVL` for the fallback path. (Foundation's `Process` derives `argv[0]` from the executable URL and can't set it independently, so the lowercase-`argv[0]` route isn't available without `posix_spawn`.)

## Proof
- `swift test --filter TailscaleSessionTests` — 6/6 pass (added candidate-ordering + CLI-environment coverage).
- `make check` — SwiftFormat + SwiftLint `--strict` clean on changed files.
- `make test` — the only failure is a pre-existing flake in `AdaptiveRefreshTimerTests` ("manual mode performs the initial refresh but no recurring ticks", `AdaptiveRefreshTimerTests.swift:117`, `RefreshCount 2 == 1`). It reproduces on unmodified `main` (3/3 runs) with my changes stashed, and is unrelated to this change (timer cadence vs. Tailscale discovery). Filed separately as #2099. Every other suite passes.
- End-to-end: under a simulated minimal GUI `PATH`, resolution now selects `/usr/local/bin/tailscale`; both `wrapper + SHLVL` and `bundle + SHLVL` return JSON headlessly, while the pre-change `bundle, no marker` path reproduces the GUI hang.

Tests are pure (no bundle/GUI launches), per AGENTS.md.
